content.text:
I fixed this with a one-line change to `packages/docusaurus-utils/src/markdownLinks.ts`.

**Cause:** Docusaurus rewrites links to `.md`/`.mdx` files into page URLs. The pattern that finds those links (in `replaceMarkdownLinks`) matched any link containing `.md`, even when more characters came right after it. So in `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png`, it took `./file.md` to be a link to the document `file.md`. It rewrote that part of the path, and the image was then looked up in `/static` and not found.

**Fix:** The `.md`/`.mdx` extension now only counts if the link ends there. That means it must be followed by one of:
- `#` (an anchor) or `?` (a query string)
- `)` or `>` (the end of the link)
- a quote or whitespace (before a link title)
- the end of the line (for `[ref]: file.md` style links)

**Checks:**
- The existing `markdownLinks` tests pass (10/10).
- I ran the updated pattern by itself against these inputs. I didn't build a site with the issue's example.
  - `./file.md__static_image_assets__/image.png` is no longer treated as a doc link.
  - `./file.md`, `./file.md#x`, `[a]: file.md` and `<a b.md>` are still matched as before.

I didn't add a regression test for this case.
